Message:
ALSA: hda - Pop noises fix for XPS13 9333

When headphones are plugged in, force AFG and node 0x02
("Headphone Playback Volume") to D0 to avoid pop noises.

Bugzilla: https://bugzilla.kernel.org/show_bug.cgi?id=76611
